tasks.name: Define business case, capacity and product slate
tasks.description: Sets the business objective, nameplate capacity, product slate and economic hurdle rate that frame the project.

needs.info: class 5 estimate (CAPEX range), economics model (NPV, IRR) for each capacity/product option
block flow diagram and preliminary yields by configuration option

tasks.name: Supply crude assays and feed cases
tasks.description: Provides the crude assay library and selects the design, check and turndown crude/blend cases.

needs.info: assay characterisation gaps and requested additional assay cuts (TBP, sulfur, metals, acidity)

tasks.name: Supply site and existing facility data
tasks.description: Provides site survey control, historic geotechnical data, climatic data and as-built drawings and capacities of existing units, utilities and offsites.

needs.info: engineering data request list with need dates
survey and geotechnical investigation scope requiring owner site access

tasks.name: Issue owner standards and specifications
tasks.description: Issues the owner engineering standards, the order of precedence against codes, and the approved vendor list.

needs.info: list of project specifications and requested deviations from owner standards

tasks.name: Define owner design basis requirements
tasks.description: States design life, on-stream factor, turndown, sparing philosophy, overdesign margins, utility conditions and environmental limits for the BOD.

needs.info: draft basis of design for owner mark-up
environmental basis: emission and effluent limits from regulations
business case: capacity and product slate

tasks.name: Set risk tolerance criteria
tasks.description: Issues individual and societal risk criteria, the corporate risk matrix and LOPA target frequencies.

needs.info: study basis for HAZID, siting and QRA requesting owner criteria

tasks.name: Approve gate decisions
tasks.description: Reviews the gate package and approves the select decision, entry to FEED and final investment decision.

needs.info: gate review package: estimate class and accuracy, schedule, risk register, execution plan
alternatives evaluation and selected configuration with yields and utility demands
HAZID and siting results with open risk items

tasks.name: Act as permit applicant
tasks.description: Submits environmental and construction permit applications as operator and passes permit conditions back to the project.

needs.info: permit application package: emission inventory, effluent quality, noise, dispersion modelling
plot plan and stack heights/locations for the application

tasks.name: Review and comment on deliverables
tasks.description: Reviews IFR deliverables (P&IDs, datasheets, layouts, specifications) and returns comment sheets through Document Locator.

needs.info: Document Locator transmittals of IFR deliverables with review due dates
IFR P&IDs and process datasheets
IFR equipment datasheets and technical bid evaluations needing owner approval

tasks.name: Provide operations and maintenance input
tasks.description: States operating, sampling, isolation and blinding, drainage, access and maintenance (removal, lifting, cleaning) requirements.

needs.info: operating philosophy, PFDs and P&IDs at IFR
equipment list and maintenance-relevant features (bundle pulls, internals removal)

tasks.name: Specify control and alarm management requirements
tasks.description: Gives operator interface, alarm management, DCS/SIS platform and integration with existing plant control requirements.

needs.info: ICS architecture and control philosophy draft
control narrative for key loops

tasks.name: Review the 3D model for operability and maintenance
tasks.description: Reviews the federated model with operators and maintainers for access, valve reach, maintenance clearances and escape routes.

needs.info: S3D model at 30/60/90 % (via Navisworks), with valve operator and platform access
Tekla platforms, ladders and stairs (via Navisworks)
operations and maintenance requirements used as review checklist

tasks.name: Take part in HAZOP and accept actions
tasks.description: Provides operations staff for HAZOP and LOPA, and approves action close-outs and residual risk.

needs.info: HAZOP/LOPA worksheets, action list and proposed responses
P&IDs issued for HAZOP and operating procedures outline

tasks.name: Provide tie-in and outage windows
tasks.description: Sets turnaround and outage windows, live-plant constraints and isolation availability for tie-ins.

needs.info: tie-in list: location, size, hot-tap vs shutdown, isolation requirements
path of construction and tie-in execution sequence

tasks.name: Approve changes
tasks.description: Approves change requests and field changes that alter scope, cost, schedule or operability.

needs.info: change request with description, cost and schedule impact
field change requests with cost and schedule impact

tasks.name: Define spare parts philosophy and approve spares
tasks.description: Sets the spares philosophy (commissioning, capital, two-year operating) and approves spares from SPIRs.

needs.info: SPIRs: part numbers, interchangeability, recommended quantities and prices
SPIR collection status and spares purchase options by PO

tasks.name: Define CMMS asset data requirements
tasks.description: Defines asset hierarchy, equipment classes, required attributes, criticality ranking and document links to be delivered at handover.

needs.info: information handover specification and document numbering
SPF tag classes and attributes available from engineering systems

tasks.name: Issue permits to work and isolations
tasks.description: Issues permits to work, isolations and site access for construction and commissioning work in or near operating plant.

needs.info: IWP scope, location, hazards and planned dates for brownfield work
isolation points from system boundary P&IDs

tasks.name: Write operating procedures and train operators
tasks.description: Writes normal, start-up, shutdown and emergency procedures and trains the operating crew.

needs.info: operating manual, control narrative and operating envelopes
alarm and trip set points (C&E)
vendor operating manuals for packages

tasks.name: Witness and accept commissioning tests
tasks.description: Witnesses MC walkdowns, loop checks, C&E tests and run-in, and signs acceptance.

needs.info: test schedule, procedures and ITRs requiring owner witness
MC walkdown schedule

tasks.name: Accept system handover
tasks.description: Reviews turnover packages and accepts each system with an agreed retained punch list.

needs.info: system turnover package, RFSU certificate and punch list
as-built drawing and data handover status

tasks.name: Load asset register and CMMS
tasks.description: Builds the asset register and loads CMMS master data from handover data, and returns gaps to the project.

needs.info: data books, IOM manuals, certified datasheets and spare part lists
tag register and attributes exported from SPF/engineering lists
approved operating spares list

tasks.name: Accept final documentation
tasks.description: Checks final as-built documentation and data books against the handover specification and accepts or rejects them.

needs.info: final as-built document set and data books transmitted through Document Locator

items.name: Business case
items.content: Project objective, nameplate capacity, economic hurdle rate, target start-up date and budget envelope.

items.name: Product slate and specifications
items.content: Products with rates, quality specifications (sulfur, flash, distillation end points) and destinations.

items.name: Crude assays and feed cases
items.content: Assay data (TBP, API, sulfur, metals, TAN) and design, check and turndown crude cases with rates.

items.name: Site conditions data
items.content: Survey control and benchmarks, climatic design data, seismic zone, historic soil data and site access rules.

items.name: Existing facility and utility data
items.content: As-built drawings and available capacity of existing utilities, flare, tankage, interconnecting piping and electrical supply.

items.name: Owner standards and approved vendor list
items.content: Owner engineering standards, order of precedence, allowed deviations, and approved vendor list by commodity.

items.name: Owner design basis requirements
items.content: Design life, on-stream factor, turndown, sparing, design margins, utility conditions, environmental limits and winterisation.

items.name: Risk tolerance criteria
items.content: Risk matrix, individual and societal risk criteria and LOPA target frequencies.

items.name: Gate decision
items.content: Approval to proceed, selected option and conditions from each gate review.

items.name: Permit approvals and conditions
items.content: Issued permits with limits and conditions (emissions, discharges, noise, construction hours).

items.name: Owner comments on deliverables
items.content: Owner comment sheets on IFR deliverables with code (approved, approved with comments, rejected).

items.name: Operations and maintenance requirements
items.content: Sampling, isolation and blinding, drains, access, lifting, bundle pull, cleaning and maintenance-free intervals.

items.name: Control and alarm management requirements
items.content: DCS/SIS platform, operator interface standards, alarm philosophy and integration with existing control room.

items.name: Owner model review comments
items.content: Model review comments by object/area on access, valve reach, maintenance clearance and escape, with action-by discipline.

items.name: HAZOP action acceptance
items.content: Owner approval of HAZOP/LOPA action responses and residual risk.

items.name: Tie-in and outage windows
items.content: Turnaround and outage dates, tie-ins allowed in each window, and live-plant work constraints.

items.name: Owner change approval
items.content: Approve/reject decision on change requests and field changes, with conditions.

items.name: Spares philosophy
items.content: Commissioning, capital and two-year operating spares policy, criticality rules and interchangeability targets.

items.name: Approved operating spares list
items.content: Approved operating and capital spares by tag and part number with quantities, for procurement.

items.name: CMMS asset data requirements
items.content: Asset hierarchy, equipment classes, required attributes per class, criticality and document link rules.

items.name: Permit to work and isolation authorisation
items.content: Issued permits to work, isolation certificates and site access for a work scope and date.

items.name: Operating procedures
items.content: Normal, start-up, shutdown and emergency operating procedures by system.

items.name: Owner test witness acceptance
items.content: Owner signatures on witnessed walkdowns, loop checks, C&E tests and run-in.

items.name: Handover acceptance
items.content: Owner acceptance of a system with the agreed retained punch list and open-item dates.

items.name: CMMS master data
items.content: Asset register loaded: functional locations, equipment records, attributes, BOMs and maintenance plans.

items.name: CMMS data gap list
items.content: Missing or inconsistent asset data by tag and attribute, returned to the project for correction.

items.name: Final documentation acceptance and deficiency list
items.content: Acceptance of as-built documents and data books, or deficiency list by document.
